description: A man in a dark peaked cap and dark, worn coat lies flat on a mossy rock ledge at the lip of a huge waterfall, peering over the edge. Behind him, several Black men in a dugout canoe paddle through fast, churning water toward the falls, with a second canoe behind. The setting is mist-filled cliffs and dense tropical trees. The clothing and canoes suggest the 19th century. I see no visible text, no frame or border, and nothing graphic.
